description: Capture structured data from in-person HCP visits including discussion topics, products discussed, attendees, next steps, and call objectives.
gaps: Video call integration for hybrid visits requires third-party connector
Real-time sentiment analysis from call notes not natively supported
notes: Core differentiator. Offline-first architecture ensures field usability in low-connectivity clinical settings.

description: GPS-based visit verification confirming the rep was physically at the account location when logging a visit.
gaps: Indoor positioning (e.g., hospital floor/wing level) not supported — GPS accuracy only
Geofencing radius is globally configured, not per-account customizable
notes: Requires device location permissions. Works offline with sync on reconnect.

description: Support for logging visits with multiple HCPs present (e.g., lunch-and-learn, group detailing).
gaps: Per-attendee product messaging differentiation is limited — all attendees receive the same content record
Attendee-level consent verification at time of group visit is manual
notes: Important for institutional selling and speaker programs.

description: Record sample distribution to HCPs with digital signature capture on mobile device, linked to lot numbers and allocation tracking.
gaps: Biometric signature verification (comparing current signature to historical patterns) not natively available
Signature image export is gated by a minimum file size threshold for compliance archival
notes: Regulatory requirement in most markets. Supports PDMA compliance and 21 CFR Part 11 electronic signature standards.

description: Configure maximum sample quantities per rep per product per time period, with real-time or batch enforcement during drops.
gaps: Real-time limit calculation requires batch job to be current — stale batch data can show incorrect remaining allocations
Cross-territory allocation pooling (shared limits across reps in a region) not supported out-of-box
notes: Batch calculation job runs on configurable schedule. Connect API endpoint available for custom integrations.

description: Periodic reconciliation of sample inventory on hand vs. expected quantities based on transactions (drops, transfers, returns, adjustments).
gaps: Automated discrepancy detection with threshold alerting requires custom reporting
Integration with external warehouse management systems requires middleware
notes: Typically run monthly. Critical for PDMA audit compliance.

description: Deliver HTML5-based interactive presentations on tablet during customer visits with slide-level engagement tracking.
gaps: Complex animations and embedded video may not render consistently across all device types
Presentation analytics are session-level — sub-slide interaction heatmaps not natively available
notes: Primary content delivery mechanism for field reps during face-to-face visits.

feature: Approved Email with Templates and Fragments
description: Send pre-approved email communications to HCPs using configurable templates with merge fields and approved content fragments.
gaps: Custom field merge in email fragments requires API-level configuration — not fully declarative
Email template previews on mobile do not always match final rendered output in recipient's email client
notes: Compliance-controlled. All emails must use approved templates.

description: Manage content lifecycle — publish new versions, link to parent documents, and retire outdated content so field users only access current materials.
gaps: Automated retirement based on expiration date requires custom automation
Version comparison (diff between old and new content) not available — only version numbering
notes: Critical for compliance. Retired content must be removed from all mobile devices during next sync.

description: Multi-level territory hierarchy (nation > region > district > territory) with rules-based and manual account-to-territory assignment.
gaps: Mid-cycle territory realignment does not automatically migrate historical visit data
Forecast integration with territory model requires separate configuration
notes: Supports multiple concurrent territory models for different business units.

description: Automated rules to assign accounts to territories based on geography (zip code, state, country) and account attributes.
gaps: Complex assignment rules (e.g., account specialty + geography + volume) require custom logic
Rule evaluation performance degrades with very large account volumes (100K+)
notes: Rules run as batch jobs. Manual overrides are supported for exceptions.

description: Capture opt-in/opt-out preferences per communication channel (email, phone, visit, digital) and enforce them when communication is attempted.
gaps: No global unsubscribe-all capability by design — per-channel consent required for compliance
Consent capture on mobile does not support all custom consent types without configuration
notes: Intentional design decision: no bulk opt-out to prevent accidental compliance violations.

description: Configure jurisdiction-specific consent behavior including GDPR double opt-in (EU), PDMA consent requirements (US), and APPI rules (Japan).
gaps: New jurisdiction rules require manual configuration — no auto-update from regulatory feed
Cross-jurisdiction HCPs (practicing in multiple countries) require manual consent resolution
notes: Consent rules are metadata-driven and can be configured per country without code changes.

description: Define target visit frequencies by account segment per cycle period (monthly, quarterly) and track actual vs. planned reach and frequency.
gaps: Dynamic frequency adjustment based on real-time field conditions requires manual template updates
Activity plan categories and criteria are distinct configuration paths that can confuse administrators
notes: Reach and frequency metrics are the primary KPIs for commercial operations.

feature: Activity Plan Criteria and Category Filtering
description: Configure which accounts are included in activity plans using criteria filters and categorize activities by type.
gaps: Custom criteria JSON is separate from the standard activity plan batch job
Complex multi-criteria rules require careful JSON construction with limited declarative tooling
notes: Category and criteria are independent configuration axes.

feature: Speaker Program and Advisory Board Management
description: Plan, execute, and track speaker programs and advisory boards with attendee management, speaker contracts, and expense tracking.
gaps: Virtual event platform integration requires third-party connectors
Speaker fair market value rate management is basic — no automated FMV benchmarking
notes: Compliance-critical module. All events require approval workflow before execution.

description: Automatically capture and aggregate HCP spend data from events for regulatory transparency disclosure requirements.
gaps: Multi-currency aggregation for global reporting requires custom configuration
Direct submission to regulatory databases requires integration middleware
notes: Data capture is automated. Submission to regulatory bodies requires export and external integration.

description: Manager-facing assessment forms with configurable competency categories, scoring rubrics, and development action plans linked to visit records.
gaps: AI-assisted coaching suggestions not natively available
Coaching score trending over time requires custom reporting
notes: Assessment forms are configurable per business unit. Coaching data is HR-sensitive and follows separate sharing rules.

description: Complete coaching assessments on mobile during field ride-alongs in low-connectivity clinical environments.
gaps: Rich media attachments to coaching sessions are limited by offline sync bandwidth
Real-time coaching collaboration between co-managers is not supported offline
notes: Critical requirement — most ride-alongs occur in hospitals with limited connectivity.

description: Full CRM functionality available offline with bi-directional sync when connectivity resumes, including conflict resolution for concurrent edits.
gaps: Sync conflict resolution defaults to server-wins — custom merge strategies require platform configuration
Initial full sync for new users with large territories can exceed 15 minutes
Sync error diagnostics are limited — silent failures require log analysis
notes: Core platform differentiator. Local storage with encrypted data at rest.

description: Native mobile applications for iOS (iPad and iPhone) and Android tablets and phones with feature parity.
gaps: iPad is the primary target device — Android tablet layouts may have minor rendering differences
Platform-specific features are not uniformly available across OS
Device-specific testing required — emulator-only validation is insufficient
notes: iOS/iPad is the dominant field device. Android support is growing in cost-sensitive markets.

description: Administrative interface for configuring all modules including user management, permission sets, feature flags, and business rules without code deployment.
gaps: Some advanced configurations still require platform setup navigation outside the admin console
Bulk configuration operations have governor limit constraints
notes: Primary administrative interface.

description: Generate and deploy metadata bundles that configure the mobile app experience without app store updates.
gaps: Metadata generation for large orgs can timeout — requires batch processing
Translation metadata syncs from server — compiled translations are overridden at runtime
notes: Server-driven mobile configuration. Changes propagate on next sync without app updates.

description: Create product orders during or after visits, track order status through fulfillment, and manage pricing and approval workflows.
gaps: Real-time pricing engine requires custom configuration
Backorder management needs custom development
Order splitting for partial fulfillment varies by implementation
Free goods and promotional order handling requires custom rules
notes: Highly customer-specific. Most implementations customize order management for their ERP integration.

description: Manage healthcare professional and healthcare organization records with affiliations, credentials, specialties, and hierarchical account relationships.
gaps: Unlimited address support requires custom address objects beyond standard
Data stewardship workflows for master data governance are implementation-specific
notes: Foundation for all other modules. NPI tracking, license validation, and affiliation management included.

description: Dashboards tracking call compliance, reach and frequency, sample utilization, territory coverage, and content engagement.
gaps: Real-time dashboards reflect data as of last sync — current-day field activity may lag
Cross-module analytics require custom report building
Predictive analytics and AI-driven insights not natively integrated
Embedded mobile analytics have limited capability compared to desktop
notes: Built on native reporting infrastructure. Custom dashboards can be built by administrators.

description: Connect with external systems for HCP/HCO master data enrichment, ERP order fulfillment, pricing, and inventory synchronization.
gaps: Native master data connectors are limited — most implementations require middleware
Real-time data enrichment requires custom integration
Order management ERP integration is highly customer-specific
Pricing engine integration requires custom development
notes: Most complex integration area. Highly variable based on customer's ERP and data landscape.

feature: Care Program Enrollment and Device Management
description: Manage patient and provider enrollment in medical device care programs with milestones, device training, and support coordination.
gaps: Complex multi-device care program workflows require significant customization
Patient data handling requires additional privacy controls
Device training tracking and certification management is basic
notes: Newer module targeting medical device and diagnostics verticals.

description: Complete audit trail of all field activities, data changes, consent modifications, and sample transactions for regulatory inspection readiness.
gaps: Long-term audit trail retention requires external archival storage
Audit trail search and export for large time ranges can be slow
notes: Non-negotiable compliance requirement. Every customer interaction must be traceable.
